evidence.title: GitHub - wix/react-native-ui-lib: UI Components Library for React Native

name: React Native UI Lib
summary: React Native component library and design-system toolset: forms, controls, lists, overlays, charts and layout.
description: Open-source React Native component library that its docs describe as a comprehensive design system with dark mode, RTL and accessibility support. 80+ documented components are grouped into basic, charts, controls, form, layout, lists, media, navigation, overlays and status, plus a foundation layer with colors, typography, assets, modifiers and a theme manager, so teams can load presets and build their own design system in three steps. Ships an Expo demo app and a Figma library.
contains: 80+ documented components across basic, controls, form, layout, lists, media, navigation, overlays, status and charts
foundation layer: colors, typography, assets, modifiers, theme manager
create your own design system in 3 steps via presets and defaults
supports dark mode, RTL and accessibility features
Expo demo app and Figma library
supports React Native 0.73; new-architecture upgrade on the roadmap
